name: Read-only review round history for task context
summary: review_rounds.read projects the validated contribution-review chain into newest-first rounds and calls review_state.effective for the same outcomes as review TASK. It bounds rounds, items, attestations, holds and terminal-safe text, preserves item dispositions and evidence, reports malformed coverage without guessing, and writes no records. work.execute routes only review TASK --rounds to this read; client.py carries standalone usage only.
